title: B-tree cursor validation, initialization, and publication

scope.rationale: btreeCursor validates root, transaction, write, lock, and read-only preconditions; maps an empty schema root to zero; initializes a cursor; marks same-root cursors as multiple; publishes it on the shared list; selects read/write pager behavior; and lazily allocates write temporary space.

external_source_responsibilities: Shared-cache table-lock establishment/checks and connection mutex ownership
dependencies.caller_closure: The initialization body is assigned. The typed model has no KeyInfo field yet, so index/table distinction remains an external caller responsibility.

inputs: Btree, positive root page, writable flag, active transaction; write requests require write transaction and writable media
outputs: Allocator-owned invalid Cursor linked into Shared or exact bounded error
contracts.ownership: On success Shared owns Cursor. On allocation/temp-space failure no cursor remains published and all cursor storage is freed.
contracts.state_and_results: Empty read-only schema root 1 maps to root 0. Same-root cursors all gain multiple. Read cursors set pager_readonly; write cursors acquire temporary space.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller/shared-cache wrapper owns lock discipline. This body allocates cursor/list/temp memory but performs no pager I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Root zero is corrupt; missing/wrong transaction or read-only write is rejected. OOM leaves list and previous cursor flags unchanged.

representation_differences: Zig allocates Cursor instead of filling caller-prezeroed opaque storage.
A boolean pager_readonly represents PAGER_GET_READONLY; writable represents BTCF_WriteFlag.
KeyInfo is not stored in this bounded Cursor model.
Explicit errors enforce several source assertions in release builds.

oracle.protocol: Exercise zero root, inactive transaction, empty schema, writable temporary-space allocation, same-root multiple marking, invalid initial state, and read-only rejection; bounded allocation suite checks publication rollback.
oracle.normalization: Allocator-owned cursor identity replaces caller storage; source flags compare by semantic booleans.

assurance.oom: Cursor allocation, list append, and temporary-space allocation are bounded; errdefers remove publication and free cursor storage before returning NoMemory.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; sharable lock wrapper and actual connection mutex remain external.
assurance.malformed_input: Root zero reports Corrupt. Absent transactions and forbidden writes report ReadOnly.
assurance.continuation: Failure leaves prior cursor list and multiple flags unchanged; success leaves an invalid cursor ready for movement.
assurance.performance: Linear scan of open cursors plus allocation; same source complexity.

integration.native_call_path: createCursor and cursorWithLock dispatch through this owner in production internal paths; broader SQL runtime still uses the separate database cursor owner.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: The prior simplified openCursor omitted empty-schema, multiple, pager-mode, read-only, and temporary-space behavior and is retired.

independent_review.notes: Requires KeyInfo/lock integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Unify with the integrated database cursor owner.
